A '''Character Weapon''' is a [[Weapon]] subtype (printed '''Weapon — Character'''). It deploys on a [[Warrior]] (or another character that can use character weapons) and is fired in battles at sites.

Do not confuse this with [[Character]], the card type.

Other weapon subtypes: [[Starship Weapon]], [[Automated Weapon]], [[Artillery Weapon]], [[Vehicle Weapon]].

Premiere examples: [[Jedi Lightsaber]], [[Vader's Lightsaber]], [[Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol]], [[Blaster]].
